caption: The load balancer splits 20 requests per second into 10 requests per second for each app server, and each stays under its 15 requests per second limit. Both app servers query the one database, so it must carry their combined 20 requests per second.

spec.title: Three-tier request path
spec.aria: A browser sends 20 requests per second to a load balancer, which forwards 10 requests per second to each of two app servers; each server is under its 15 requests per second limit and both query one database at a combined 20 requests per second.
